rv.q: The actors bounce off of each other's physical impulses like a pinball machine, each gesture setting off a chain reaction of escalating physical comedy.

Indeed, it is his precise pacing, with actors running on and offstage, coming in and out of doors, climbing up, down, over, and under furniture pieces, that makes each piece a wild, zany, and blissful romp.
As a slice of comedy history, this production was fascinating.

cn.t: Critics find "The Farce Awakens" a mostly enjoyable romp, with Feydeau's physical comedy and ensemble energy earning praise. Direction keeps things lively, though uneven execution leaves some wanting more polish.
